annotations.title: Find the right browser tool for a file job

description: Given a job to do on a PDF, photo or other file (for example "combine three PDFs", "remove the location from a photo", "HEIC to JPG"), returns the vaultan.app browser tool that does it, with its address and what it does. The tools run in the web browser on the person's own device: the file is not uploaded and no account is needed. For a conversion it also says whether that pair of formats is supported.

task.description: The job in plain words, for example "make a PDF smaller" or "png to pdf".

name: suggest_browser_tool
